card.name: Punctuation before a professor title
card.fires_on: Commas or other short words right after a physician's name and degree (e.g. 'MD,'), where a title like 'Professor of Medicine' comes next. Also fires on words in academic faculty listings.

modes.label: Comma after name and degree
modes.description: A comma after a doctor's name and MD, just before an academic title such as Professor.
modes.example: David C. Dugdale, III, MD<<,>> Professor of Medicine, Division of General Medicine

modes.label: Faculty or appointment lines
modes.description: A word in a list of credentials and teaching posts, where 'Professor' could follow.
modes.example: , FACOG, Chief, Eastside Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Group Health Cooperative of Puget Sound, Redmond, Washington;<< Clinical>> Teaching Faculty, Department

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict 'Professor' or 'Prof' as the next word.
card.plain: It fires where a doctor's name is followed by an academic title like Professor.
